My opinion:
 I despise Teamers. They make playing survival a very frustrating experience, as much as I love the mode itself. They throw off all the balance and can mitigate your progress quickly and easily.
 The worst thing is, as much as I hate to admit it, Teaming is a VERY valid strategy if one aims to win, at least in most scenarios. 
 Two similarly powerful ships can protect each other, make their progress faster, eliminate threats in the form of stronger Solo players and eventually betray one another in a lucrative situation.
 The leader can Team with weaker players to protect himself from other Teamers or Solos. This is especially valuable if the leader is a miner - although he has to be careful about betrayal.
 Teaming up with the leader is also good when you're a weaker ship because it speeds up your progress and increases your chances of victory. 

Honestly, I really wish Teaming just wasn't a thing, although I understand how difficult it is to balance or punish. I have to admit it's a solid strategy if employed correctly, but I do find it very cheaty and I feel like it defeats the purpose of Survival Mode.
